remarks: **Applicants must have good credit and positive rental references.**  Welcome to 252 Seaside Avenue - a stunning first-floor unit offering modern, stylish living just two blocks from the beach. This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath apartment features spacious, sun-filled rooms with high-end finishes throughout. The thoughtfully designed layout includes two oversized bedrooms with a central open-concept living and dining area in between, ideal for comfortable living and entertaining.  Enjoy the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer, central air, and ample off-street parking located behind the home. Just a quick 1-minute drive to I-95 and situated right on the Darien border, the location offers easy commuting and access to everything Stamford has to offer. Ideal layout for 2 occupants.  Walk or bike to Cove Island Park, and embrace all the perks of coastal living.  No pets or smoking permitted.
